import re,os,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# find separator columns (all 3s)
seps=[j for j in range(19) if all(inp[i][j]==3 for i in range(4))]
print(seps)
blocks=[]; start=0
for s in seps+[19]:
    if s>start: blocks.append((start,s)); start=s+1
print(blocks)
masks={}
for a,b in blocks:
    col=inp[0][a]
    masks[col]=[[1 if inp[i][j]==col else 0 for j in range(a,b)] for i in range(4)]
    print(col, sum(sum(r) for r in masks[col]))
print(out)
